_doc: Measure-first (council B3139q-r17, owner-approved rec): how often does strat_squeeze_setup_long's share-dependent layer-1 gate - short_interest_pct >= 0.20 with days_to_cover >= 8 - decide differently when short interest is divided by the share count KNOWN at the settlement date instead of today's? The live code divides every 2022-2026 settlement by ONE undated Finnhub profile2 count cached 2026-05. PIT denominator: SEC dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding (the cover-page count), fetched per company from the companyconcept endpoint with the project's configured SEC contact header; for settlement date D, facts filed on or before D, latest 'end'. A FLIP is a settlement pair where the two denominators disagree at the gate; the base is the pairs where either passes.

headline.band: core: Finnhub / dei between 0.5 and 2 (same-order counts)
headline.reading: the bias is one-sided: most flips are names that cleared the gate at the time and fail on today's larger post-dilution count

band_note: the per-ticker suspect filter judges each ticker by its LATEST pair only, so an absurd early fact survives it (BTDR's 20-F reported a count of 1); the per-pair bands bound that - 'all' includes such errors, 'wide' admits heavy real dilution (AAOI 2.34x)

coverage.population_rule: any pair with SI/denominator >= 0.1 on the Finnhub or weighted-average denominator

prototype_proxy.reading: the 10-Q WEIGHTED-AVERAGE count the prototype used runs below the cover-page count (a period average lags dilution), so it overstated the at-the-time passes; the dei figures supersede it

not_measured: trade-level impact: layer 1 also needs (1c) smart money and layers 2-3 triggers, so changed TRADES need an engine run
FINRA's own settlement-to-publication lag (S6-B3139ba covers it)

multi-class issuers are not identified: FINRA short interest is per symbol, while a dei count can be per class or a company total (how SEC's endpoint treats per-class facts is UNVERIFIED here), so such a pair may sit outside the ratio bands or inside them unflagged
owner_fork: S6-B3139bd: source dated shares (a data task; the squeeze verdicts move) or label short_interest_pct non-PIT (a disclosure)
